vertical_reference: Source NEON elevations, no vertical shift applied; matching 2026_SOAP_9 DTM used to normalize heights.

cloud.encoding: uint16 little endian, interleaved easting, northing, absolute elevation, height above matching DTM
cloud.sampling: One measured return nearest each occupied 3D voxel centre; occupied voxels selected by deterministic spatial hash if over the display limit. No synthetic points, coordinate shifts or gap filling.
cloud.hash: SplitMix64 over voxel index; deterministic, independent of return density
cloud.density_note: Display density is intentionally balanced; displayed point counts are not canopy density or biomass estimates.
